name: Invisible Collar to Chill Dog
summary: The bottom holder opens the second Invisible Collar leg while retaining the neck-cleared knee hug, returning to Chill Dog with the first high-leg connection supported.
description: The bottom holder opens the second Invisible Collar leg while retaining the neck-cleared knee hug, returning to Chill Dog with the first high-leg connection supported.
overview:
The bottom holder opens the second Invisible Collar leg while retaining the neck-cleared knee hug, returning to Chill Dog with the first high-leg connection supported.

Begin as the bottom holder with the two-leg Invisible Collar enclosure established. Remove any finishing pressure before opening the high-leg arrangement.

Preserve the first neck-cleared knee-hug connection as you prepare to open the second leg. Open the second leg through a comfortable hip angle without wrenching the foot or knee. The completed reset is Chill Dog/Bottom with the neck-cleared connection retained. If the first connection also releases, recognize ordinary closed guard before attempting another high-leg entry.

Practice cooperatively with controlled movement. Stop at any tap, verbal signal, or distress; release all joint or neck pressure before changing direction. Do not force a trapped knee, shoulder, or neck to preserve the route.

defender.description: Recognize Invisible Collar to Chill Dog and interrupt its required connections before the final control is established.
defender.overview:
You oppose the performer of this action. Wait for finishing pressure to release before changing posture. Maintain an inside frame as the second leg opens. Keep the head and shoulder aligned through the opening. Recognize that the first Chill Dog connection can still constrain posture. Recover ordinary guard posture only after the remaining high connection clears.
